data.summary: Senior Project Manager & Delivery Lead with over 15+ years of leadership experience driving complex Digital Banking Transformations, core payment network integrations with VISA, Mastercard, AMEX and Discover, and multi-region software delivery. Proven track record managing global cross-functional squads (100+ engineers) across Cards and Digital Payments domains. Expert in orchestrating end-to-end PM governance, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Risk & Dependency Management, and AI-enabled PMO automation to improve release velocity and deliver 100% on-time compliance for tier-1 financial institutions. Certified PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, and Microsoft AI Transformation Leader.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
FIS Global Business Solutions | Chennai, India Value Stream Lead / Senior Project Manager & Delivery Lead
Apr 2021 – July 2026
Directed end-to-end delivery roadmaps for 4–6 distributed cross-functional engineering squads delivering digital banking and payment compliance solutions.
Maintained a 100% on-time record for critical card payment network compliance mandate releases across VISA, Mastercard, AMEX, and Discover.
Resolved 95%+ cross-squad blocking dependencies ahead of PI execution, mitigating critical release blockers across multi-region banking deployment pipelines.
Architected and deployed custom Copilot AI PMO workflows, automating RAID log tracking and executive status reporting, cutting consolidation time by 50%.
Partnered with Enterprise Architects, Product Owners, and Client Stakeholders to drive digital customer journey modernization, delivering RESTful API and microservices architectures for real-time account servicing and tokenized card authentication.
FIS Global Business Solutions | Chennai, India Project Manager / Agile Delivery Lead
Jan 2017 – Mar 2021
Operationalized SAFe frameworks across 15+ global teams (120+ engineers), driving an average 20–25% increase in release velocity and reducing release cycle turnaround from quarterly to bi-weekly. Facilitated large-scale Agile Release Train (ART) syncs, quarterly Inspect & Adapt workshops, System Demos, and Scrum of Scrums for distributed teams across India and the US delivery centers. ● Elevated sprint commitment-to-delivery ratios from 65% to 88% and cut cycle time by 18% using

data-driven retrospectives and Agile metric governance.
Directed delivery for high-visibility digital initiatives including Apple Pay network tokenization rollout and specialized merchant spend-filtering platforms for Walmart.
FIS Global Business Solutions | Chennai, India Project Manager / Scrum Master
Apr 2014 – Dec 2016
Managed full-lifecycle delivery of core transaction-processing modules, transaction authentication engines, and financial technology platforms.
Blended traditional PM controls (WBS baselines, RAID tracking, budget alignment) with Agile sprint cadence for cross-border banking clients.
Ensured strict compliance with international security and financial standards across transaction processing systems.
Vertiv Inc. (USA) / Vertiv Development Center | Chennai, India Project Manager
Aug 2013 – Apr 2014
Managed technical delivery roadmaps for a dedicated banking technology center supporting multi-million-dollar accounts.
Governed end-to-end regulatory compliance and risk management initiatives, including Basel II/III and Dodd-Frank regulatory reporting pipelines.
Dun & Bradstreet (D&B) | Chennai, India Associate Manager - Projects
Jun 2008 – Jul 2013
Delivered 4 international Credit Bureau platforms (Commercial, Consumer, Mortgage, Micro-Finance) for Central Banks across international jurisdictions (Oman, Qatar, Libya, Nigeria) under World Bank/IFC mandates.
Structured end-to-end PMO governance, milestone tracking, and stakeholder reporting across distributed engineering, QA, and BA teams.
Recognized with CEO and Customer Excellence Awards for on-time, within-budget international program delivery.
EARLY CAREER HISTORY

ICEGEN Computing | Project Manager / System Analyst (Nov 2003 – May 2008)
Led technical project execution for enterprise client solutions, including asset-tracking systems for global financial clients (HSBC, Standard Chartered).
BIOSOFT | System Analyst (Jan 2000 – Nov 2003)
Handled legacy software modernization and client-server migrations.
